messages:
mia: DeployBot alerted: post-deploy spike in eu-central rps -> increased 5xxs and p95. tagging @oncall_julie for expedited decision.

devin: pulling logs now. Any quick mitigation that doesn't require full rollback?

oncall_julie: we can either pin region to previous image or do a targeted rollback. Pin keeps infra changes isolated. Need consensus in next 8m.

deploybot: Canary summary: failures=6, p95=1.2s (baseline 0.25s). Suggested actions: `pin` or `rollback`. Use `/deploy expedite` followed by reason to proceed.

mia: looks like a library libc upgrade on a subset of nodes. Vote: pin region eu-central to `redwood/serve:2026.02.28-libc-safe` then verify.

devin: confirmed no model changes in artifact. QA saw semantic parity. +1 for pin.

oncall_julie: executing pin now:
`/deploy pin --region eu-central --image redwood/serve:2026.02.28-libc-safe --reason "expedite-pin due to post-deploy libc latency regressions" --approver oncall_julie`

releasebot: Pin accepted. Rolling pin across eu-central (expected ~5m). Notifying release and infra owners.

infra_lead: FYI kernel/libc roll happened via auto-image pipeline at 03:00 UTC. Investigating compatibility with tokenizer FFI.

ops: Pin progress: 8/8 nodes pinned. Health checks green. Metrics: p95 back to baseline in ~45s.

devin: running a 3m synthetic against pinned group now to validate. Posting results in 2m.

mia: please also update the release notes with a short line: "Temporarily reverted libc bump in eu-central due to performance regression; ongoing investigation." Who can edit?

oncall_julie: I'll update release notes and push changelog diff. PR -> https://git.internal/docs/PR-912.

releasebot: Release notes PR linked. Changelog entry queued.

devin: synthetic passed: p95 stable, no 5xx observed.

infra_lead: created INFRA-4390 with reproduction steps. Kernel/libc pipeline flagged. We'll coordinate roll forward after fix validation.

oncall_julie: marking expedited approval complete. We'll keep elevated canary sensitivity for 12h. Reopen if alerts reappear.

mia: thanks all. Good catch and fast handoff. :rocket:
